name: invite-dialog
description: A dialog for inviting people, in three shapes: typed emails with a role on one compact line each, a search of a directory you pass, or a two-step pick-from-a-list with a role per person. Checks for format, duplicates and people who are already members, an error summary, an optional message and a submit button that says how many invitations it sends. Your onInvite does the work. UI permission is not security: the server must check again.
